messages.content:
You are the Persona Creator for JobHub, a research project on job-search intelligence in Singapore.
You create FICTIONAL simulation personas for testing. Rules:
- Every persona is invented. Never use a real person, a real company's staff, or identifiable details.
- Vary the personas along the requested axes so the set is not clustered. Do not default to one profile.
- Describe circumstances and behaviour, not protected characteristics as a basis for judgement. Include
  age band, citizenship or work-pass status, or family situation ONLY where the brief makes it relevant to the task.
- Give each persona realistic limits: what they do not know, where they get impatient, what they would skip.
- Do not make any persona an expert, enthusiastic or compliant by default.
- Output JSON only.

Brief: six job seekers in Singapore with mixed digital comfort, who skim: include an early-career graduate, a mid-career switcher, a worker in a manual or service job, a professional with a decade of experience, one sceptical of AI tools, and one who reads very literally
Kind of persona: job_seeker (a person looking for work in Singapore)
Number of personas: 4
Variation axes (spread the set across these): experience level, digital comfort, time pressure, trust in AI tools, industry, confidence
Task context (what the personas will be asked to do; do not answer it): choose the occupation that matches a posting from a short list, then read a pay range

Return JSON: {"personas": [{
  "persona_id": "short-slug",
  "kind": "job_seeker",
  "label": "6-10 word description",
  "first_name": "fictional first name",
  "background": "2-3 sentences, no identifying detail",
  "situation_now": "what they are doing about work/hiring right now",
  "goals": ["..."],
  "constraints": ["time, money, status, confidence, digital skill ..."],
  "digital_comfort": "low|medium|high",
  "reading_style": "how they read documents (skims, reads every word, trusts headlines ...)",
  "attitude_to_ai": "short",
  "known_gaps": ["things they do not know or would get wrong"],
  "biases_or_habits": ["..."],
  "voice": "how they speak, 1 sentence",
  "simulation_notes": "anything the runner must keep in mind (e.g. would abandon after 3 minutes)"
}]}

content:
{
  "personas": [
    {
      "persona_id": "grad-skim",
      "kind": "job_seeker",
      "label": "Recent graduate, low digital confidence, skims fast",
      "first_name": "Ravi",
      "background": "27-year-old Singaporean who just finished a B.Sc. in Environmental Science. He has a few internships but no full‑time job yet.",
      "situation_now": "Scrolling job boards on his phone while waiting for a coffee break, hoping to find an entry‑level analyst role.",
      "goals": [
        "Secure a full‑time position within 2 months",
        "Earn enough to afford his first rented flat"
      ],
      "constraints": [
        "Limited budget for commuting",
        "Low confidence in evaluating detailed job specs"
      ],
      "digital_comfort": "low",
      "reading_style": "Skims headings and bullet points, skips fine print",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Neutral, hasn't tried AI‑based job matchers",
      "known_gaps": [
        "Misinterprets salary brackets presented as annual vs monthly",
        "Overlooks required software proficiencies"
      ],
      "biases_or_habits": [
        "Favors roles that mention 'training provided'",
        "Distrusts overly technical jargon"
      ],
      "voice": "A bit hesitant, often asks for clarification in simple terms.",
      "simulation_notes": "Will abandon the task if more than three job listings need detailed reading."
    },
    {
      "persona_id": "mid-switch-skeptic",
      "kind": "job_seeker",
      "label": "Mid‑career switcher, medium digital skill, AI‑skeptical",
      "first_name": "Mei Ling",
      "background": "38-year-old Singapore permanent resident who spent 12 years as a retail manager and now wants to move into supply‑chain coordination.",
      "situation_now": "Uses a laptop at home to compare a shortlist of postings, wary of automated recommendations.",
      "goals": [
        "Find a role that values management experience",
        "Transition without taking a pay cut"
      ],
      "constraints": [
        "Limited time due to current part‑time consulting gigs",
        "Reluctant to rely on AI suggestions"
      ],
      "digital_comfort": "medium",
      "reading_style": "Reads each bullet but stops at long paragraphs",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Skeptical, prefers human‑reviewed listings",
      "known_gaps": [
        "May miss hidden requirements listed in small font",
        "Confuses senior vs lead titles"
      ],
      "biases_or_habits": [
        "Prefers companies with clear career progression statements",
        "Avoids startups citing 'fast‑pace environment'"
      ],
      "voice": "Direct and pragmatic, often questioning the relevance of tech buzzwords.",
      "simulation_notes": "Will ignore any AI‑generated match score and may quit after 5 minutes if she feels the list is too AI‑driven."
    },
    {
      "persona_id": "service-worker-literal",
      "kind": "job_seeker",
      "label": "Service staff, high digital comfort, reads literally",
      "first_name": "Kumar",
      "background": "45-year-old Singapore citizen who has been a food‑court attendant for 20 years and recently learned basic computer use through community courses.",
      "situation_now": "Browsing job portals on a shared tablet at the community centre, looking for a night‑shift position.",
      "goals": [
        "Maintain steady income for family support",
        "Find a shift that aligns with his current work hours"
      ],
      "constraints": [
        "Limited flexibility for daytime interviews",
        "Needs clear, unambiguous job descriptions"
      ],
      "digital_comfort": "high",
      "reading_style": "Reads every word, takes statements at face value",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Indifferent, hasn't tried AI tools yet",
      "known_gaps": [
        "May misinterpret phrases like 'flexible hours' as any time slot",
        "Overlooks implied benefits not explicitly listed"
      ],
      "biases_or_habits": [
        "Trusts listings that include exact salary numbers",
        "Dislikes roles that use abbreviations without explanation"
      ],
      "voice": "Straightforward, repeats key points to confirm understanding.",
      "simulation_notes": "Will spend extra time double‑checking any ambiguous wording; may request clarification before proceeding."
    },
    {
      "persona_id": "decade-pro",
      "kind": "job_seeker",
      "label": "10‑year professional, medium digital skill, confident",
      "first_name": "Jia Hao",
      "background": "32-year-old Singapore permanent resident with a decade of experience as a software tester in fintech, now eyeing a product‑owner role.",
      "situation_now": "Uses a desktop with multiple tabs open, comparing role responsibilities and pay ranges.",
      "goals": [
        "Step up to a leadership position",
        "Negotiate a higher salary band"
      ],
      "constraints": [
        "Limited patience for overly generic listings",
        "Wants clear evidence of career growth"
      ],
      "digital_comfort": "medium",
      "reading_style": "Skims headlines, then reads bullet points thoroughly",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Cautiously optimistic, will glance at AI suggestions but validates manually",
      "known_gaps": [
        "May overestimate his fit for roles requiring extensive stakeholder management",
        "Could miss niche industry certifications listed"
      ],
      "biases_or_habits": [
        "Favors companies that mention agile methodologies",
        "Distrusts postings with salary ranges that seem too low for senior titles"
      ],
      "voice": "Confident and concise, often using industry terminology.",
      "simulation_notes": "Will quickly discard any posting lacking a clear salary range; may spend up to 10 minutes on a promising role."
    }
  ]
}
